title.sl: Have you ever …? · Že kdaj ali včeraj?
title.de: Have you ever …? · Schon mal oder gestern?
title.it: Have you ever …? · Mai o ieri?
title.en: Have you ever …? · Ever, or yesterday?

description.sl: Izkušnja do zdaj: have + deležnik (I've never seen a raven, Have you ever …?). Ko poveš, kdaj, preteklik: I saw it yesterday. Gone in been, just, already, yet.
description.de: Erfahrung bis jetzt: have + Partizip (I've never seen a raven, Have you ever …?). Sagst du, wann: Past simple (I saw it yesterday). Gone und been, just, already, yet.
description.it: L'esperienza fino a ora: have + participio (I've never seen a raven, Have you ever …?). Se dici quando: past simple (I saw it yesterday). Gone e been, just, already, yet.
description.en: Experience up to now: have + the participle (I've never seen a raven, Have you ever …?). Say when, and it's the past simple: I saw it yesterday. Gone and been, just, already, yet.

exercises.prompt: I ___ Arthur at the market yesterday.

explain.sl:
**Poveš kdaj (yesterday): preteklik, ne have**
- **I saw him yesterday.** · Včeraj sem ga {m:videl|f:videla}.
explain.de:
**Du sagst wann (yesterday): Past simple, nicht have**
- **I saw him yesterday.** · Ich habe ihn gestern gesehen.
explain.it:
**Dici quando (yesterday): past simple, non have**
- **I saw him yesterday.** · L'ho visto ieri.
explain.en:
**You say when (yesterday): the past simple, not have**
- **I saw him yesterday.**

exercises.prompt: Arthur isn't here. He ___ to the market.

explain.sl:
**gone: je šel in je še tam; been: je bil in se je vrnil**
- **He's gone to the market.** · Šel je na tržnico (in ga ni).
- **He's been to the market.** · Bil je na tržnici (in je nazaj).
explain.de:
**gone: ist hin und noch dort; been: war dort und ist zurück**
- **He's gone to the market.** · Er ist auf den Markt gegangen (und noch weg).
- **He's been to the market.** · Er war auf dem Markt (und ist zurück).
explain.it:
**gone: è andato ed è ancora lì; been: c'è stato ed è tornato**
- **He's gone to the market.** · È andato al mercato (e non c'è).
- **He's been to the market.** · È stato al mercato (ed è tornato).
explain.en:
**gone: went and is still there; been: went and came back**
- **He's gone to the market.**
- **He's been to the market.**

explain.sl:
**V vprašanju in nikalnici yet na koncu; v trdilni already**

explain.de:

explain.it:
**In domande e negazioni yet alla fine; nelle affermazioni already**

- **I've already finished.** · Ho già finito.
explain.en:
**In questions and negatives yet at the end; already when you say yes**

- **I've already finished.**
